messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['One of your Google Ads Customer s account attached to your MCC Account has stopped running this morning.', 'How are you today?  I write to inform you that we have already sent you The USD$5000.00 dollars through Western Union as we have been given the mandate to transfer your full compensation payment total sum of USD$395,000.00 via Western Union by this government.', 'Our security team has been receiving complaints from our customers for unauthorized use of the Santander online banking.', 'Access to your accounts has been blocked due to a system error.', 'For your safety, PayPal set your account status to limited.', 'we notice some suspicious activities on your online banking, and we are putting a hold on your account for your protection.', 'Your PayPal Account Will Be Deactivated', 'Your Online Bank Account has been temporarily Suspended.', 'This is an automatic message from our servers; If you are receiving this message it means that your email address has been queued for deactivation.', 'This transaction cannot be completed due to errors present in your account information.', 'Your PayPal account is Limited.', 'We would like to inform you that we have released a new version of Bank of America Customer Form.', 'Important - Internet Banking is about to get even safer', 'YOUR EMAIL (ID) HAS WON GBP£820,000.00 ONLY IN YAHOO LOTTERY PROMOTIONS HELD IN YEAR 2009.', 'Your DHL parcel arrived at our post office since 5th June 2017.', "THERE HAVE BEEN MULTIPLE INVALID LOGON ATTEMPTS TO YOUR ABBEY ONLINE BANKING ACCOUNTS FROM MULTIPLE BLACKLISTED IP'S.", 'Cahoot has updated its enhanced security system which will virtually eliminate fraud and totally protect you.', 'During the regular update and verification process of HSBC Account, we could not verify your current information.', 'WE HAVE TEMPORARILY LIMITED YOUR ACCOUNT SENSITIVE FEATURES DUE TO THE SUCCESSFUL UPDATE OF OUR NEW SECURITY ALERTS SERVICE!', 'In accordance with Scotia Bank Online User Agreement and to ensure that your account has not been accessed from fraudulent locations, access to your account has been limited.', 'We detected irregular activity on your Alliance & Leicester Bank Account on 20 June 2010.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
